lastTask: Implement Byte 15b-a model critic over scored chorus candidates

projectState.summary: Byte 15b-a adds the first model critic on top of Byte 15a's deterministic melody repair substrate. `MelodyRepairTake` now exposes a bounded candidate menu of raw, heuristic, and alternate chorus repairs; `src/ollama.ts` sends only scored candidate IDs and critique context to the model; the model can return only `selectedCandidateId` plus short prose fields. Valid model selections switch the active repaired chorus candidate through the existing lookahead material path, while invalid/failed/stale output falls back to the deterministic scorer. The model still never emits notes, pitches, timing, scores, or playback instructions.
